latest_substantive_result.scientific_status: Source-reported and not independently reproduced. Hall figure points lack experimental uncertainty; motor data are sparse and partially archived. Failure to identify priming does not rule it out. No natural mechanism is established.
latest_substantive_result.summary: N622 gives K_eff=aI+(c-a)Q and predicts the three-variant [111] slope (2a+c)/3 under stated assumptions. N623 reports one resolved late validation event, whose identity changes under fixed sensitivity settings; robust delayed activation was not identified.

mechanisms_under_investigation: A [111] geometry and full-tensor trace can test the orientation-only Hall model if its effective-medium assumptions hold.
Motor priming versus mechanical masking remains observationally unresolved.
next_decisive_step: Acquire calibrated raw tensor data and reproduce the selected motor pipeline; make no physical claim before uncertainty and identifiability are addressed.
status_note: No new observations or research-script runs were performed; model predictions and the inconclusive screen remain separate from discovery.
strongest_obstacle: The Hall result lacks raw matched measurements and its medium assumptions may fail. Hidden priming and mechanically pinned engagement can have identical observed emissions in the motor model.

task.goal: Preserve conditional physical predictions and negative observational evidence without inferring a new law or mechanism.
task.question: Can calibrated transport and motor interventions distinguish domain redistribution from other mechanisms and latent priming from mechanical torque masking?
task.scope: N622-N623 only; no full raw-data replay, causal attribution or new physical experiment.
